The engagement is on a contractual basis for an initial period of one year. Candidates who do not draw a pension get between Rs.1,00,000/- and Rs.1,50,000/- per month (all inclusive). how_to_apply: Applications are made on paper in the prescribed format given as Annexure-I of the notice. The application should reach on or before 10 December 2026 at this address: The Office of the Divisional Head, Development Research Division, Indian Council of Medical Research, 3rd Floor, NIMS Building, V. Ramalingaswami Bhawan, Ansari Nagar, New Delhi - 110029.

The Annexure-I form asks for the post applied for, the advertisement number, the candidate's name, father's/spouse's name, date of birth, present age, sex, category, correspondence and permanent addresses, mobile number, email id, educational qualifications, experience starting from the present employer, and any other relevant information. A signed declaration is also included.

The DG, ICMR reserves the right to accept or reject any application without giving any reason. No correspondence or recommendation will be entertained. The DG, ICMR reserves the right to fill or not fill the advertised post. Any addendum or corrigendum will be uploaded only on the ICMR website, https://icmr.gov.in. Canvassing in any form will be a disqualification. The decision of the Competent Authority will be final and binding.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Post Graduate degree in Management. Working experience of Extramural/Intramural Research Programmes. Knowledge of computer applications. The age of the candidate must be not more than 65 years on the last date of receipt of the applications, which is 10 December 2026. The notice does not mention any age relaxation. Qualification and experience should be in the relevant discipline/field and from a reputed institution or organisation recognised by the competent authority. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post.

rows.essential_qualification_and_experience: Retired from Central/State/Autonomous/PSUs with a Bachelor degree in any discipline, in Pay level-7 and above, with at least 12 years' experience in the field of Administration in Central/State/Autonomous/PSUs
At least 12 years of experience in the field of Administration in Central/State/Autonomous/PSUs, with a Post Graduate degree in Management

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The initial term of engagement is one year. Any extension can be considered on a case-to-case basis, depending on the job requirements and subject to the performance evaluation made by the Competent Authority. The total engagement shall not be more than five years or until the candidate attains the age of 70 years, whichever is earlier. The Senior Consultant shall not be entitled to any other perquisites such as honorarium or allowances like Dearness Allowance, Residential Telephone, Transport Facility, Residential Accommodation, Personal Staff, CGHS and Medical Reimbursement. No TA/DA is admissible for joining the assignment or on its completion. Retired government officials engaged as Senior Consultant will be allowed TA/DA for travel inside the country in connection with official work, as per their entitlement at the time of retirement. Working hours are the same as for regular employees of ICMR; no extra benefit is allowed for working beyond office hours. Paid leave of absence may be allowed at the rate of 1.5 days for each completed month of service. No remuneration is paid for absence beyond the authorised leave, and leave not taken is not carried forward on renewal. Maternity leave is as per the Maternity Benefit Act of the Government of India. Unauthorised absence for a continuous period of 08 days without valid reasons leads to automatic termination of the engagement.

content_sections.heading: ICMR Recruitment 2026 Job Description
content_sections.text: The notice lists the following scope of work for the position: To assist in all administrative matters of Extramural Research Programmes of short duration, low cost proposals, ad-hoc projects, Task Force projects, National Registry, Centers of Advanced Research, Capacity Building/support for sustained high quality research etc. To assist in all administrative matters of Intramural Research Programmes of short duration, low cost proposals, ad-hoc projects, Task Force projects, National Registry, Centers of Advanced Research, Capacity Building/support for sustained high quality research etc. Any other duty assigned by the competent authority from time to time.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for ICMR Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications are made on paper in the prescribed format given as Annexure-I of the notice. The application should reach on or before 10 December 2026 at this address: The Office of the Divisional Head, Development Research Division, Indian Council of Medical Research, 3rd Floor, NIMS Building, V. Ramalingaswami Bhawan, Ansari Nagar, New Delhi - 110029. A recent passport size photograph affixed on the application form, and the candidate's signature. Self-attested copies of proof of age. Self-attested photocopies of educational qualification certificates. Self-attested photocopies of experience certificates and testimonials. A copy of the PPO. Proof of caste certificate issued by the competent authority (from the category column of the form).

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: Shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview. The intimation will be sent to their registered email id. Selection of the candidate will be based on performance in the interview. Eligible candidates have to bring all the documents in original for verification on the date of the interview. No TA/DA will be paid to attend the interview. Candidates must arrange their own stay for the interview, and after joining the post if selected. The DG, ICMR reserves the right to prepare a panel of waitlisted candidates, valid for one year.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in ICMR Recruitment 2026 for Senior Consultant?
faq.answer: There is one post of Senior Consultant (Extramural/Intramural Research) in the Development Research Division, ICMR Hqrs., New Delhi.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the ICMR Senior Consultant post?
faq.answer: The application should reach the Office of the Divisional Head, Development Research Division, ICMR, New Delhi on or before 10 December 2026. Late applications will be rejected.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is required for the ICMR Senior Consultant post?
faq.answer: Retired Government employees need a Bachelor degree in any discipline, Pay level-7 and above, and at least 12 years' administration experience in Central/State/Autonomous/PSUs. Alternatively, professionals need at least 12 years' administration experience in such organisations and a Post Graduate degree in Management.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the ICMR Senior Consultant post?
faq.answer: The age must be not more than 65 years on the last date of receipt of applications, which is 10 December 2026.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the ICMR Senior Consultant?
faq.answer: Candidates not drawing pension get Rs.1,00,000/- to Rs.1,50,000/- per month (all inclusive), as decided by the Selection Committee.

faq.question: Q6. How is the pay fixed for retired employees who draw a pension?
faq.answer: For pensioners, remuneration is as per O.M. No.3-25/2020-E.IIIA dated 9th Dec., 2020 issued by DoE, M/o Finance: last pay drawn minus pension plus Travelling Allowance if applicable.

faq.question: Q7. How to apply for ICMR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Send the application in the Annexure-I format, with self-attested copies of qualification and experience certificates and a copy of the PPO, to the Development Research Division, ICMR, 3rd Floor, NIMS Building, V. Ramalingaswami Bhawan, Ansari Nagar, New Delhi - 110029.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for the ICMR Senior Consultant post?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates will be called for an interview by email, and selection will be based on performance in the interview.

faq.question: Q9. Is the ICMR Senior Consultant post permanent?
faq.answer: No, the engagement is purely on a contractual basis for an initial one year. Any extension is case to case, up to a total of five years or until the age of 70, whichever is earlier.

faq.question: Q10. Will ICMR pay TA/DA for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No, no TA/DA will be paid to attend the interview or to join the post.
